subjects.description: A pile of heavy industrial dark sand cast iron yokes and brackets ({parts}) inside a large open shipping bin
subjects.appearance_details: Solid dark grey sand cast iron with a fine,  grainy casting texture, rounded cast edges, visible seams; subtle handling scuffs and workshop dust, mostly matte with restrained natural highlights
subjects.relationship: The components are loosely stacked and overlap naturally, as if collected for transport or inspection
subjects.location: Inside a deep industrial bin lined with wrinkled, translucent clear plastic
subjects.relative_size: The bin and metal parts fill most of the frame
subjects.pose: Parts rest in a believable, irregular pile, with their weight supported by the pieces beneath them
subjects.action: The parts and bin remain still; only a very slow, steady camera move

background_setting: A working factory floor around the open bin: worn grey concrete, faintly visible industrial rollers and equipment, and only partial glimpses of workers in high-visibility orange clothing at the frame edges. Keep the bin and parts as the clear focus.

lighting.conditions: Ordinary overhead factory lighting with soft ambient warehouse light, neutral and slightly cool
lighting.direction: Broad overhead illumination with gentle reflections across the metal and plastic liner
lighting.shadows: Soft, natural contact shadows between the overlapping parts; avoid dramatic or theatrical contrast

aesthetics.composition: Close high-angle view into the open bin, slightly oblique rather than perfectly top-down; the pile of parts is centered and clearly visible, with the plastic liner folded over the bin rim
aesthetics.color_scheme: Natural dark grey metal, clear plastic, muted concrete, and small accents of industrial orange

cinematography.camera_motion: Nearly static overhead-oblique camera with a very subtle, smooth push-in; no orbiting or abrupt movement
cinematography.framing: Close view into the bin, including its plastic-lined rim and enough surrounding factory floor to establish the setting
cinematography.camera_angle: High angle looking down into the bin, matching a person documenting the parts from nearby
cinematography.depth_of_field: Deep, natural focus across the bin and parts
cinematography.lens_focal_length: Natural wide-angle phone-camera perspective with mild edge distortion

style_medium: Unedited documentary footage recorded on a modern phone in a real factory
artistic_style: Photorealistic live-action appearance: preserve believable metal weight and geometry, subtle surface imperfections, realistic transparent plastic folds and reflections, natural exposure, and restrained color. Avoid a 3D-rendered, glossy, toy-like, or over-sharpened look.
context: A real factory worker documenting a bin of sand cast iron components during normal production
